name: Baked White Fish with Lemon Cream Sauce, Mash and Green Beans

components.name: Fish in Lemon Cream Sauce

ingredients.name: Raw skinless boneless mild white fish fillets

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Pat fish fillets dry and spread in one layer in a shallow baking dish.
Gently melt butter with cream, Dijon, garlic, shallot and lemon; whisk until combined without boiling hard, then pour around fish.
Bake 12-18 minutes depending on fillet thickness until centre of fish registers 63 C; spoon the cooked sauce over the fillets.
Pack each meal with fish and sauce, mashed potato and beans, keeping the fish and mash separated when possible for gentle reheating.

components.name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until tender, drain and mash with butter, milk and salt.

components.name: Green Beans
steps: Cook green beans by steaming or quick oven-roasting with measured oil until tender.
